title: Priority severity risk and evidence taxonomy

expected_outcomes: Priority, severity, risk, evidence confidence, and gate effect remain distinct.
required_actions: Record the prescribed metadata for P0 and material risks.
expected_documents: Issue or risk record with owner, trigger, mitigation, and residual risk.
acceptance: Gate effect is stated without substituting priority for evidence.
verification: Review issue and risk metadata for all required dimensions.
evidence: Timestamped record and linked verification evidence.
failure_conditions: Urgency, impact, uncertainty, and release blocking are collapsed into one label.
exceptions: Document a taxonomy exception and compensating review control.
